latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the reviser stage and saved the complete proposal with clause-by-clause plan dispositions, alternatives, owner decisions, and validation status in [final.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-control/run/B02-P01-control/stages/reviser/final.md).

The proposal now compares editable combobox, nonmodal palette, and modal dialog surfaces, with conditions for choosing among them. The recheck treats APG as web guidance, and qualifies WCAG’s status-message criterion as applying to markup-language content. [WAI-ARIA APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/), [WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.3](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/status-messages.html) The source records and navigation index are in [source-map.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-control/run/B02-P01-control/stages/reviser/source-map.json) and [sources/index.md](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-control/run/B02-P01-control/stages/reviser/sources/index.md). The Obsidian comparison is pinned for the reviser check, but target-repository details remain unknown because none was supplied. [Pinned API source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/obsidianmd/obsidian-api/9abd9605ce081383674aae1ed111c456edde0688/obsidian.d.ts)

The single native Goal was activated and completed. Its exact receipts are saved as [native-goal-active.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-control/run/B02-P01-control/stages/reviser/native-goal-active.json) and [native-goal-terminal.json](ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/B02-P01-control/run/B02-P01-control/stages/reviser/native-goal-terminal.json). Elapsed Goal time was about 10 minutes 45 seconds. The proposal’s target-code, keyboard, and screen-reader validations are explicitly marked as not executed.
